Plan alignment: does the implementation match the plan; are deviations justified; is all planned functionality present?

Architecture: sound design, performance, security, integration with surrounding code.
Testing: real behaviour, edge cases, all passing.
Production readiness: docs, no obvious bugs.

1. Can I cite the exact file and line? If not, drop the finding.

- CommonJS (require/module.exports). package.json has no `type` field; never add one.

- Text arguments must be strings; non-string throws TypeError whose message starts with "<functionName>:". Out-of-range numeric args throw RangeError with same prefix. Tests assert on error class and message prefix, never full message.
